_comment: Copy to sip_config.json and fill in. These are SUBACCOUNT SIP passwords, NOT your API password and NOT your portal password. Find them under Sub Accounts > Manage Sub Accounts > edit (pencil icon).
_password_note: PREFERRED: leave 'password' out entirely and set an environment variable instead - VOIPMS_SIP_PASSWORD_<LABEL>, uppercased with non-alphanumerics as underscores. So label 'main-line' reads VOIPMS_SIP_PASSWORD_MAIN_LINE. This folder is typically cloud-synced, and a SIP password permits outbound calling at your expense.
_did_note: 'did' is display-only - it labels the row in the dashboard. Use 'dids': [..] if one subaccount receives for several numbers. Run 'python voipms_watch.py map' to discover which subaccount each number uses.

defaults._log_message_bodies: Off by default. Inbound texts are 2FA codes and password resets more often than not, and SIP is unencrypted. With this off, sip_messages.log still records sender and timestamp - enough to prove a message reached VoIP.ms - without keeping the secret on disk.
